name: teachable
description: Shared Teachable CLI/local MCP:26 default tasks,123 with explicit beta opt-in.
long_description: 21 stable v1 and97 opt-in beta v2 Admin operations plus5 local workflows. Named profiles pin API versions. Effects require explicit per-call approval. Production dependencies are bundled; school API outcomes and actual desktop GUI installation are separate validation.

api_key.title: Private school Admin API key
api_key.description: Choose API key OR private credential JSON file, never both. Provider API access and permissions still apply.

credentials_file.title: Absolute owner-private credential JSON file
credentials_file.description: Regular non-symlink JSON containing api_key; on POSIX owner-only permissions. Leave API key empty when using this.

api_version.title: Admin API version
api_version.description: Use 1 for stable v1 or 2 for request-access beta with enable_v2 checked and an appropriate scoped key. No version fallback.

enable_v2.title: Explicitly enable beta v2 tasks
enable_v2.description: Expose97 additional v2_ tasks. This does not grant provider beta access. Set API version2 only for a beta school/key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide/directly refuse all effects:19 default reads or64 reads with beta enabled. Local policy does not reduce API-key permissions.

allow_destructive.title: Allow explicitly confirmed operations
allow_destructive.description: False refuses effects even when confirmed. No operation is automatically approved.
